failure: Failure: A zero-free promise does not recognize itself from local input, compute M e or e^T M, normalize thermal quantities, or provide physical acquisition/nonunitary implementation. No polynomial-cost state-preparation, thermal-normalization or finite-temperature capability follows; exponential postselection examples are explicit. The theorem extends a source-cited PSD mechanism but originality is not claimed.
interface: Interface: All matrices may be complex, nonnormal, non-PSD and varying; they share the same supplied whole-layer LY(r) promise. Products and contractions use bilinear transposes without conjugation. The estimate is conditional on the global zero-free promise for every factor.

claims.title: Complex Lee–Yang operators have sharp spectral separation and varying products approach rank one
